Figure 1:ProgramDistill evaluates reference-guided software engineering for
interactive web applications.A coding agent is given a workingreferenceapplication whose source implementation is hidden
and an editablecurrentapplication with missing functionality.
The agent interacts with the reference to infer the intended behavior, restores that
behavior by modifying the current implementation, and validates the result against the
reference.

Figure 2:Overview of the mine–craft–patch pipeline.Miningdiscovers replayable behaviors
and organizes them into a prerequisite trace tree by extending previously
verified traces.Craftingconstructs atomic repair
tasks by masking one behavior, or combines masks along a lineage to construct
progressively deeper cumulative repair tasks.Patchingasks a coding agent to restore
the masked functionality from a working reference, then replays the corresponding
lineage traces to measure how much of the behavior chain has been recovered.

Figure 3:A behavioral dependency inTrello (Knowankit).Account setup (τ1\tau_{1}, represented by the icon) precedes board/card
creation (τ2\tau_{2}) and the editor interaction (τ3\tau_{3}).
The brackets group panels (a)–(b) into one trace and
panel (c) into its dependent trace.

Figure 7:Partial-application reconstruction performance.(a)Mean binary score versus mean cost per trajectory (USD).(b)Mean binary score by restoration depthrLr_{L}.
Performance generally declines as depth increases.
Figure19in AppendixH.2shows the same panels under the chain score.

Figure 8:Partial-application reconstruction on a depth-8Trello (Vdevired)task.The depth-8 task spans eight dependent workflow stages—login, project setup, team and board setup, list and card creation, permissions, card details, cross-list movement, and comment editing—all of which must remain functional together.
Across 317 steps, Claude Opus 5 repeatedly alternates betweenOBSERVE REFto infer intended behavior,EDIT CODEto modify the implementation, andOBSERVE CURRENTto validate the repair
before final submission.
